ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; the visible ventral surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and in sparse scattered specks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is a continuous dark field with high-contrast, roughly circular white/light-grey clusters located at the lateral tips of both lobes. Sporadic, low-density high-intensity specks are distributed across the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch is a visible V-shape with an approximate vertex angle of 70 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations are observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with higher irregularity and pixel-amplitude peaks on the upper-left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit a smooth concave curvature extending towards the tips; trailing edges follow a broadly linear but highly serrated path from the median notch to the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters (barnacles) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, prominent, high-contrast diagonal white linear disruption (approximately 15% of lobe length) is visible on the upper-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization on distal tips and a singular long linear scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific orientation and length of the white linear abrasion on the right lobe in combination with distal tip barnacle clusters.
